primary_user_question: עד כמה אפשר לסמוך על זה?
ux.default_experience: answer-first; technical provenance progressively disclosed; original source opens directly where lawful
ux.answer_model: proposition-grounded multi-source synthesis with high relevance threshold and numbered claim-level citations
ux.regular_mode: concise answer-first synthesis plus numbered evidence list
ux.researcher_mode: extended evidence analysis with subclaims, witness provenance, verification scope, context completeness, source-type/period/audience distinctions, Evidence Families, tensions and unanswered aspects
ux.language_policy: cross-language retrieval across Hebrew, Yiddish, English and any additional direct/authorized source languages; translations are derived, not independent witnesses
ux.precision_policy: precision over recall; lexical-only matches rejected; insufficient evidence is an acceptable result

verification_surge.homogeneous_batch_target: 20-50 records when direct authorized item witnesses are stable and rights permit
blocking_reasons: metadata ambiguity or unresolved identity/dedup conflict

development_recovery.primary_bottleneck: Bibliographic identities are not inspected content; maintenance had no acquisition step and no content inspection.
development_recovery.required_agent_action: Continue direct public-body inspection across Hebrew, Yiddish and English; prioritize pending AIDs whose publisher pages expose body text, preserve Evidence Family identity and translation dependency, run reconciliation and both answer modes, and do not retry the known 403 crawler.
development_recovery.last_run_note: Batch 063 inspected nine public text-index pages for Igrot Kodesh vol. II letters רמא–רמט. Eight existing identities were enriched; AID 4666284 was added as Parsed via Pnimi's secondary index and linked to the existing Shanghai correspondence family. Twenty new source-grounded paraphrases were added; three existing propositions for AID 4666281 were migrated from a duplicate alias without double-counting. Family IDs were reconciled across the Shanghai and Rebbe-mother correspondence chains; four metadata aliases were linked. Expected answer-eligible unique families 663→666, content-verified unique families 660→663, propositions 2022→2042. Direct Chabad.org reader routes returned shells; Pnimi index and publisher search excerpts were used without access-control bypass. Actions and live publication remain pending.
